column3: “You have ill-treated me” is rendered “to wrong me”; the meaning of the Hebrew verb is uncertain.
“Torn me down” is rendered “breaks me down.”
“The sojourners of my house” is rendered “Those who live in my house.”
“The sons of my womb” is rendered “my own brothers”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The men of my council” is rendered “my associates.”
“Who will give” is rendered “Oh that,” and “scroll” as “book.”
“My vindicator” is rendered “my Redeemer,” and “last” as “at the last.” “Dust” is rendered “the earth.”
“After my skin people have struck off this” is rendered “after my skin is destroyed”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
The Hebrew reads “in me”; NASB has “against him” and supplies “pretext for a case.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Iniquities of the sword” is rendered “the punishment of the sword.” The ending is difficult, and the meaning is uncertain.
